datasets.name: validation_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) as total_validations,
  SUM(CASE WHEN row_count_match = 'Pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as row_count_pass,
  SUM(CASE WHEN column_count_match = 'Pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as column_count_pass,
  SUM(CASE WHEN schema_match = 'Pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as schema_match_pass,
  SUM(CASE WHEN distinct_count_match = 'Pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as distinct_count_pass,
  SUM(CASE WHEN row_count_match = 'Pass' AND column_count_match = 'Pass' AND schema_match = 'Pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as success_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN row_count_match = 'Fail' OR column_count_match = 'Fail' OR schema_match = 'Fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failure_count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    row_count_match, column_count_match, schema_match, distinct_count_match, load_time
  FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_mysql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mysql') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    row_count_match, column_count_match, schema_match, distinct_count_match, load_time
  FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_redshift
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'redshift') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    row_count_match, column_count_match, schema_match, distinct_count_match, load_time
  FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_pgsql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'postgres_sql') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    row_count_match, column_count_match, schema_match, distinct_count_match, load_time
  FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_bigquery
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'bigquery') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    row_count_match, column_count_match, schema_match, distinct_count_match, load_time
  FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_mssql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mssql') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    row_count_match, column_count_match, schema_match, distinct_count_match, load_time
  FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_snowflake
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'snowflake') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
) combined_data

datasets.name: validation_trends
queryLines:
WITH validation_status AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(load_time) as validation_date,
    CASE 
      WHEN row_count_match = 'Pass' AND column_count_match = 'Pass' AND schema_match = 'Pass' 
      THEN 'Pass' 
      ELSE 'Fail' 
    END as final_status,
    COUNT(*) as validation_count
  FROM (
    SELECT row_count_match, column_count_match, schema_match, load_time
    FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_mysql
    WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mysql') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT row_count_match, column_count_match, schema_match, load_time
    FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_redshift
    WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'redshift') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT row_count_match, column_count_match, schema_match, load_time
    FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_pgsql
    WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'postgres_sql') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 UNION ALL
    SELECT row_count_match, column_count_match, schema_match, load_time
    FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_bigquery
    WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'bigquery') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 UNION ALL
    SELECT row_count_match, column_count_match, schema_match, load_time
    FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_mssql
    WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mssql') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 UNION ALL
    SELECT row_count_match, column_count_match, schema_match, load_time
    FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_snowflake
    WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'snowflake') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  ) combined_data
  GROUP BY DATE(load_time), 
    CASE 
      WHEN row_count_match = 'Pass' AND column_count_match = 'Pass' AND schema_match = 'Pass' 
      THEN 'Pass' 
      ELSE 'Fail' 
    END
)
SELECT 
  validation_date as time_key,
  final_status as validation_status,
  validation_count
FROM validation_status
ORDER BY validation_date

datasets.name: validation_details
queryLines:
SELECT
  source,
  source_full_table_name,
  target_full_table_name,
  load_time,
  row_count_source,
  row_count_target,
  row_count_match,
  distinct_count_source,
  distinct_count_target,
  distinct_count_match,
  column_count_source,
  column_count_target,
  column_count_match,
  source_column_type_count,
  target_column_type_count,
  column_type_count_match,
  schema_match,
  CASE 
    WHEN row_count_match = 'Pass' AND column_count_match = 'Pass' AND schema_match = 'Pass' 
    THEN 'Pass' 
    ELSE 'Fail' 
  END as final_status
FROM (
  SELECT 
    source, source_full_table_name, target_full_table_name, load_time,
    row_count_source, row_count_target, row_count_match,
    distinct_count_source, distinct_count_target, distinct_count_match,
    column_count_source, column_count_target, column_count_match,
    source_column_type_count, target_column_type_count, column_type_count_match,
    schema_match
  FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_mysql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mysql') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_show_failed = 'No' OR 
         (:param_show_failed = 'Yes' AND 
          (row_count_match = 'Fail' OR column_count_match = 'Fail' OR schema_match = 'Fail')))
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    source, source_full_table_name, target_full_table_name, load_time,
    row_count_source, row_count_target, row_count_match,
    distinct_count_source, distinct_count_target, distinct_count_match,
    column_count_source, column_count_target, column_count_match,
    source_column_type_count, target_column_type_count, column_type_count_match,
    schema_match
  FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_redshift
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'redshift') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_show_failed = 'No' OR 
         (:param_show_failed = 'Yes' AND 
          (row_count_match = 'Fail' OR column_count_match = 'Fail' OR schema_match = 'Fail')))
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    source, source_full_table_name, target_full_table_name, load_time,
    row_count_source, row_count_target, row_count_match,
    distinct_count_source, distinct_count_target, distinct_count_match,
    column_count_source, column_count_target, column_count_match,
    source_column_type_count, target_column_type_count, column_type_count_match,
    schema_match
  FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_pgsql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'postgres_sql') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_show_failed = 'No' OR 
         (:param_show_failed = 'Yes' AND 
          (row_count_match = 'Fail' OR column_count_match = 'Fail' OR schema_match = 'Fail')))
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    source, source_full_table_name, target_full_table_name, load_time,
    row_count_source, row_count_target, row_count_match,
    distinct_count_source, distinct_count_target, distinct_count_match,
    column_count_source, column_count_target, column_count_match,
    source_column_type_count, target_column_type_count, column_type_count_match,
    schema_match
  FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_bigquery
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'bigquery') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_show_failed = 'No' OR 
         (:param_show_failed = 'Yes' AND 
          (row_count_match = 'Fail' OR column_count_match = 'Fail' OR schema_match = 'Fail')))
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    source, source_full_table_name, target_full_table_name, load_time,
    row_count_source, row_count_target, row_count_match,
    distinct_count_source, distinct_count_target, distinct_count_match,
    column_count_source, column_count_target, column_count_match,
    source_column_type_count, target_column_type_count, column_type_count_match,
    schema_match
  FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_mssql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mssql') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_show_failed = 'No' OR 
         (:param_show_failed = 'Yes' AND 
          (row_count_match = 'Fail' OR column_count_match = 'Fail' OR schema_match = 'Fail')))
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    source, source_full_table_name, target_full_table_name, load_time,
    row_count_source, row_count_target, row_count_match,
    distinct_count_source, distinct_count_target, distinct_count_match,
    column_count_source, column_count_target, column_count_match,
    source_column_type_count, target_column_type_count, column_type_count_match,
    schema_match
  FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_snowflake
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'snowflake') AND load_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_show_failed = 'No' OR 
         (:param_show_failed = 'Yes' AND 
          (row_count_match = 'Fail' OR column_count_match = 'Fail' OR schema_match = 'Fail')))
) combined_data
ORDER BY load_time DESC

datasets.name: source_filter_options
queryLines:
SELECT 'ALL' as source_option
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT source as source_option
FROM (
  SELECT source FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_mysql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mysql') AND source IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT source FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_redshift
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'redshift') AND source IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT source FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_pgsql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'postgres_sql') AND source IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL
  SELECT source FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_bigquery
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'bigquery') AND source IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL
  SELECT source FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_mssql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mssql') AND source IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL
  SELECT source FROM migration_catalog.validation_schema.validation_log_snowflake
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'snowflake') AND source IS NOT NULL
) combined_sources
ORDER BY source_option
